prerequisites.detail: The engine binds loopback with no authentication by default (port 8080), so the gateway reaches it only through a trusted, operator-configured private base address from the deployment record.

provider.notes: WaaV Infer is the operator's own inference engine. The gateway has a distinct id for it: INFER_STT_PROVIDER_ID = "waav-infer" (gateway/src/core/stt/infer.rs:23), which is also the id the speech-to-speech realtime adapter reports (gateway/src/core/realtime/infer/protocol.rs:130-132). For speech-to-text the adapter is a stub whose connect always fails (infer.rs:59-65) and it is deliberately left out of the plugin registry (gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:2096-2130), so a session that names this provider gets the registry's unknown-provider error today. The aliases are those at infer.rs:24 without self-hosted, which that line still lists but which now names the self_hosted provider. Through Bud a WaaV Infer engine is expected to be published as vendor self_hosted with a base address ending in /v1 (an inference; the publishing route is an open decision), and then the self_hosted rows apply, with the profile waav-infer-file when the operator declares it; these rows exist so that a session naming waav-infer directly resolves to a stated answer instead of the global default. default_model is null: the engine hosts one speech-to-text model per process and an empty model means that model. The speech-to-speech realtime provider is a separate path that these rows do not touch.

transports.disabled_reason: Not implemented and not recommended. The engine's socket only buffers audio until a finalize frame and then runs the same one-shot transcription as the upload route, so it gives no interim text and no accuracy or compute gain; the gateway adapter is a stub whose connect always fails.

gateway_client.code_ref: stub: gateway/src/core/stt/infer.rs:59-65 (connect always errors), :38 (default address ws://127.0.0.1:8123/v1/realtime); engine socket: waav-infer/crates/waav-infer-server/src/ws.rs:644-851, :1324-1372
gateway_client.notes: The engine serves GET /v1/ws on port 8080; the stub's default address names port 8123 and path /v1/realtime, which the engine does not serve. Binary frames are appended to a buffer (ws.rs:837); on a finalize frame the whole buffer is decoded, resampled and transcribed in one call (ws.rs:1338) and exactly one final transcript is sent. A per-session language or key terms are rejected at the handshake (ws.rs:373-401). The socket closes after 30 seconds idle, at most 64 sessions are open at once, and a session may hold at most 100 MiB of audio (lib.rs:157-160); the 100 MiB figure is recorded here as the upload limit. The adapter is deliberately absent from the plugin registry (gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:2096-2130).

when_unusable.code_ref: gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:2096-2130 (the speech-to-text stub is deliberately not registered, so the registry answers with its unknown-provider error); gateway/src/core/stt/infer.rs:59-65 (the stub's connect always fails)

refusal.text: WaaV Infer transcribes one uploaded audio clip per request and has no live streaming interface for transcription. This gateway does not yet serve a WaaV Infer model on a live call for this session. Ask the operator to enable segmented speech-to-text, which uploads each utterance to the engine, or choose a streaming transcription model.

billing.notes: Operator-owned engine; no vendor meter. Only uploaded segments reach it.

provenance.notes: Verified by reading the engine and gateway source on 2026-10-03. Every speech-to-text model WaaV Infer hosts is file-only at the serving interface today, whatever its architecture: the engine's model contract is one call that takes a whole clip and returns text (waav-infer-core/src/model.rs:676-687), and no production code emits a partial transcript. The engine accepts as model the loaded family id, any string that starts with it, the generic names stt and asr, and an empty string (engine.rs:2750-2764; lib.rs:1647-1662), so this default row is the normal match, not an exception. Whether a model streams is recorded nowhere the gateway could read it (not in the model manifest, not in /capabilities, not in /v1/models), which is why it is declared here.

transports.disabled_reason: Not implemented. The gateway has no per-utterance upload adapter, and it cannot reach WaaV Infer for speech-to-text at all today: the only adapter is a stub whose connect always fails (gateway/src/core/stt/infer.rs:59-65).

measurements.conditions: Median engine-side model wall time for one transcription by whisper-base, on a GB10 GPU with ONNX Runtime, one model on the GPU, no batching. No network, detection or queueing is included. Larger Whisper models are unmeasured, and the whisper-base figure must not be assumed for them.

latency.notes: No end-of-speech-to-final figure exists; the entry is engine-side inference time only.

rates.note: Engine default (waav-infer-server/src/lib.rs:48, :151); the operator may change it. A request that waits more than 2 seconds for admission is answered with HTTP 429 admission_rejected, which is load shedding and must not open the breaker.

gateway_client.code_ref: engine route: waav-infer/crates/waav-infer-server/src/lib.rs:1598-1765 (POST /v1/audio/transcriptions); gateway request code to extract: gateway/src/handlers/transcribe.rs:769-814 and :947-1027
gateway_client.notes: Request restrictions enforced by the engine, each answered with HTTP 400 (unsupported_param): a non-empty language or prompt (lib.rs:1564-1574, :1663-1676); any response_format other than json or text, so verbose_json fails (lib.rs:1704-1715); any temperature other than 0 (lib.rs:1576-1596). The model field must be empty or name the loaded family, otherwise model_not_found (lib.rs:1647-1662; engine.rs:2750-2764). Unknown fields such as stream are read and ignored. The response is {"text": ...} only: no timestamps, no confidence, no detected language. Send 16 kHz audio, because the engine otherwise resamples linearly. Limits are the engine defaults (lib.rs:144-166, :48): 100 MiB upload, 64 concurrent requests, a 2 second wait for admission and then HTTP 429 with code admission_rejected, a 30 second deadline per request. A 429 from the engine is load shedding and must not count as a failure for the circuit breaker (gateway/src/core/resilience/infer_reject.rs). Concurrent uploads are folded into one batched forward pass of up to 24 clips with no added delay (waav-infer-server/src/stt_coalescer.rs:26-33, :142-145). The engine binds loopback with no authentication by default and serves one speech-to-text model per process.

provenance.notes: Verified by reading the engine and gateway source on 2026-10-03. Whisper family: the family id whisper, and any id starting with whisper (such as whisper-1 or whisper-large-v3) when a Whisper model is loaded (engine.rs:2750-2764). The engine pads every clip to a 30 second window (waav-infer-components/src/mel.rs:79-82) and cuts longer audio at hard 30 second boundaries (waav-infer-core/src/stt/whisper.rs:277-291), so the gateway must split at a pause and must not raise its 25 second segment cap. Each call costs a full 30 second encoder pass whatever the clip length. The language comes from the model directory only; it cannot be set per request.

provenance.notes: Verified by reading the engine and gateway source on 2026-10-03. Nemotron family (ids nemotron_speech and nemotron_rnnt, engine.rs:1617-1632; waav-infer-core/src/model.rs:957). The architecture is a cache-aware streaming transducer, but the engine creates fresh caches inside each call and runs the chunk loop to the end before it returns (waav-infer-core/src/stt/nemotron.rs:131-152). It is therefore file-only through WaaV Infer today. When the engine gains an incremental speech-to-text session that keeps caches across calls and emits partial transcripts, this row gains a live_stream transport ahead of the upload.

provenance.notes: Verified by reading the engine and gateway source on 2026-10-03. Voxtral Realtime family (id voxtral_realtime, or the lower-cased architecture name voxtralrealtimeforconditionalgeneration; engine.rs:1617-1632; waav-infer-core/src/model.rs:985). The model is built for streaming with a 480 ms delay fixed in the export, but the engine runs the encoder once over the whole clip with empty caches (waav-infer-core/src/stt/voxtral.rs:1-12, :248-262). It is therefore file-only through WaaV Infer today, and flips to a live_stream transport only after the same engine work as the Nemotron family.
